suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO vs Threading: When to Stop Blocking
suggestion.rationale: Developers constantly struggle to choose between concurrency models in Python. Explaining the GIL, cooperative multitasking, and preemptive threads with crystal-clear visual diagrams captures immense search volume and maximizes watch-time.
suggestion.hook_angle: Stop using threads for I/O bound tasks until you understand how the Python GIL is secretly destroying your throughput.
